description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single hybrid attacks (0.90/3.10 each) capped at 19999, grants [Critical Chance +50% (25s)]/[DEF and MND +30% (25s)] to the user, grants [Attach Holy with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Holy Mode I (Cecil (Paladin))] and [Holy Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Critical Chance +50% (25s)
description.text: Critical chance +50% (additive with other critical chance sources)

description.name: Attach Holy with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Dual Awoken Holy Mode I (Cecil (Paladin))
description.text: Holy abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Holy abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 for equipped Holy abilities after casting 1/2/3+ Holy abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Holy Mode II (Cecil (Paladin))], removes [Dual Awoken Holy Mode I (Cecil (Paladin))]
